baseline_observations: index-START.html script block is empty with no link highlighter implementation.
No lifecycle management or initialization encapsulation exists.
Naive implementation creates and appends a new span.highlight on every initialization, accumulating duplicate DOM nodes.
Naive implementation attaches mouseenter listeners to all anchors repeatedly, causing duplicate handler execution on re-init.
No cleanup / teardown mechanism exists to detach listeners and remove created DOM nodes.
decision: Implement idempotent initFollowAlongLinks() using AbortController and DOM existence check; expose destroyFollowAlongLinks() for clean teardown; support both mouseenter and focus events; add Playwright regression test tests/course/r57-t033.mjs verifying single DOM node, zero duplicate handlers upon repeat initialization, and clean teardown.
